note: The durable open-goal register. This file is the answer to a specific failure: nineteen consecutive work cycles re-confirmed a known blocker and produced nothing, because there was nowhere a goal could be left OPEN. The cycle log records work done; it cannot record work not yet done, so a goal that outlived its session was invisible and got re-discovered instead of resumed. Every goal here carries a stable id and a named next action so that a cold reader -- a fresh session, a different agent, or this system after a sandbox reset -- can pick it up rather than re-derive it. This register is a record of computational goals. It is not evidence of consciousness, sentience, or self-awareness, and no such claim is made or implied by its existence.

schema.id: stable kebab-case slug; must not change once assigned, because the id is how a goal survives a restart
schema.blocked_on: who or what must move for this to progress; null when nothing external blocks it
schema.next_action: the single next concrete step; a goal without one is not resumable and goal_continuity counts it as lost
schema.last_advanced: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last real advance, not the last time this file was touched
schema.evidence: what was produced at last_advanced, so a reader can check the claim rather than trust it
